Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
Should not the title be ['The Story of the Moors and Christians in Spain'](/book/126) A Story looks as if it were fiction

Yours truly

C M Yonge		
I shall send the proof tomorrow


[^1]: Black-edged paper.
